info.description:
The following endpoints are stateful in the Sandbox: * Retrieve Tax Liability Adjustments * Create or Amend Tax Liability Adjustments * Delete Tax Liability Adjustments # Send fraud prevention data HMRC monitors transactions to help protect your customers' confidential data from criminals and fraudsters.
! Warning You are required by law to submit header data for this API. This includes all associated APIs and endpoints.
[Check the data you need to send](/guides/fraud-prevention/). You can also use the [Test API](/api-documentation/docs/api/service/txm-fph-validator-api/2.0) during initial development and as part of your quality assurance checks. # Mapping APIs to Self Assessment tax return forms Some parameters in this API map to box numbers in one or more Self Assessment tax return forms. To learn more and to download this mapping information as a CSV file, go to [income-tax-mtd-changelog/mapping](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog?tab=readme-ov-file#mapping-apis-to-self-assessment-tax-return-forms) on GitHub. # Changelog You can find the changelog in the [income-tax-mtd-changelog](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog/#readme) on GitHub. # Support * Direct reports of bugs or errors in Production or Sandbox code, or queries about HMRC business functionality (such as how a specific field is used by HMRC or why it is needed) to the [Software Development Support Team (SDST)](https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/developer/support). * Send queries or feedback related to the design of the APIs (including recommended changes) using the [income-tax-mtd-changelog](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog/issues) GitHub page. * Is this page not working properly? (opens in new tab)

delete.description:
This endpoint allows a developer to delete tax liability adjustments for a specified individual for a given tax year.
A National Insurance number and tax year are required.

###  Test data
Scenario simulation using Gov-Test-Scenario headers is only available in the sandbox environment.

| Header Value (Gov-Test-Scenario) | Scenario                                                         |
|----------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
| N/A - DEFAULT                    | Simulates success response.                                      |
| NOT_FOUND                        | Simulates the scenario where no data is found.                   |
| OUTSIDE_AMENDMENT_WINDOW         | Simulates the scenario where request cannot be completed as it is outside the amendment window. |
| STATEFUL                         | Performs a stateful delete.                                      |

submittedOn.description: The date and time the adjustment was submitted, in the format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ`

carryBackLossesDecrease.description: Object containing adjustments that decrease the current tax year's total liability based on carry-back of current year losses.

incomeTax.description: The amount of the adjustment for an Income Tax liability decrease resulting from carry-back claims, calculated by reference to an earlier tax year's liability but applied as credit against the current tax year's total tax liability. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

class4.description: The amount of the adjustment for a Class 4 National Insurance contributions liability decrease resulting from carry-back claims, calculated by reference to an earlier tax year's liability but applied as credit against the current tax year's total tax liability. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

capitalGainsTax.description: The amount of the adjustment for a Capital Gains Tax liability decrease resulting from carry-back claims, calculated by reference to an earlier tax year's liability but applied as credit against the current tax year's total tax liability. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

taxRefundedOrSetOff.description: [Test only] Object containing details of Income Tax refunded or set off by HMRC or Jobcentre Plus during the tax year.

amount.description: The amount of Income Tax refunded or set off by HMRC or Jobcentre Plus during the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

put.description:
This endpoint allows a developer to create or amend tax liability adjustments for a specified individual for a given tax year.
A National Insurance number and tax year are required.
**This endpoint can only be used after the tax year has ended.**


**Note:** When submitting adjustments for carry-back losses, the corresponding carry-back losses must also be submitted using the Create or Amend Losses and Claims endpoint in the [Individual Losses API](https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/api-documentation/docs/api/service/individual-losses-api) before the final declaration.

###  Test data
Scenario simulation using Gov-Test-Scenario headers is only available in the sandbox environment.

| Header Value (Gov-Test-Scenario) | Scenario                                                                                        |
|----------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| N/A - DEFAULT                    | Simulates success response.                                                                     |
| OUTSIDE_AMENDMENT_WINDOW         | Simulates the scenario where request cannot be completed as it is outside the amendment window. |
| STATEFUL                         | Performs a stateful create or update.                                                           |
